records.actualInstructionExcerpt: Make a useful local single-user Screen Demo Framer: owned landscapeMP4, explicit continuous20–60second range,1–6shots each >=1second, fixed manually selected9:16 source crop OR Fit with padding per shot, intentional hard cuts only. One versioned strictly validated plan drives preview/export. Preserve source bytes, save/reopenJSON only with matching sourceSHA. No automatic tracking, no smooth keyframes, no subtitles engine/cloud/model runtime/social uploading. Warn about upscaling, do not promise pixels can be restored. Keep optional source audio. Input contract1920x1080/2560x1440,CFR25/30,H264MP4,squareSAR,rotation0,<=300seconds/500MiB,none or oneAAC track; explicitly reject unsupported media instead of pretending universal support. Output1080x1920/30fps/H264yuv420p andAACwhenpresent. Use exact agreed boundaries, narrow only with explicit recorded blocker/controller decision, not silent claim changes.
